text: FAA guidance indicates a loss of control link triggers reestablishment attempts and contingency procedures if unsuccessful, and that loss of VLOS triggers pre-determined remote procedures; an example notes the hazard when control is lost over people. The DJI Matrice 4T manual states that a lost signal prompts automatic RTH if configured, that the RTH path may be shown by DJI Pilot 2 before loss, and that the aircraft uses Advanced RTH and will remain in RTH even if the signal returns, with brake-and-hover behavior when vision conditions are unsuitable, leading to Original Route RTH. There is no usable evidence for DJI Matrice 4T incident reports (unverified accounts).
